relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: by activating the NF-κB signaling pathway, TNF-α and IL-1β encourage matrix degradation and cell death in the intervertebral disc

relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: COX-2 catalyzes the conversion of arachidonic acid to prostaglandin E2 (PGE2)

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: PGE2 can directly up-regulate the expression of HIF-1α

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: further accelerates the breakdown of the intervertebral disc matrix by making (MMPs) and ADAMTS more expressed

relationships.subject: IL-6
relationships.evidence_quote: The JAK/STAT3 pathway facilitates the proliferation and differentiation of osteoclast precursors by increasing IL-6

key_findings: Review: IVDD and osteoporosis co-morbidity is driven by biomechanical coupling, inflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6) acting via NF-kB, and senescence signaling.
COX-2/PGE2 forms a positive feedback loop amplifying inflammation in the disc.
